name: graphql-core-incremental-modular-sdl-661b
instr:
graphql-core cannot incrementally validate independently owned, named GraphQL SDL modules. Build `SDLValidationWorkspace` with revisioned results, immutable snapshots, and schema construction. Changes must cost work proportional to the changed document and match combined-SDL validation.

Adds, replacements, and removals are transactional. Failure preserves the revision, modules, validated snapshot, and reusable rule summaries. `SDLWorkspaceUpdateError` is a Exception reporting the failure. Every successful revision deterministically reconciles module and base-schema diagnostics while preserving source locations.

Custom rules and built-in SDL rules for schema and operation roots, type extensions, nested arguments, directive and type names, enum values, and object, interface, and input-object fields revisit only changed modules and retract removed facts. Definitions and extensions retain single-document coordinate scoping, kind checks, collisions, and suggestions. Each SDL rule exposes `summarize_module` for retaining and independently reconciling module facts.

A `snapshot` permanently binds its revision's modules, schema association, diagnostics, and rule outcomes. Construction and extension consume exactly a successful supplied snapshot and reject diagnostics before returning a schema. Without `SDLValidationWorkspace`, preserve `validate_sdl`, schema utilities, custom-rule visitation, diagnostic ordering, messages, locations, and schema-aware behavior.
